title: VeriCoder: Enhancing LLM-Based RTL Code Generation through Functional Correctness Validation
authors_zh: Anjiang Wei, Huanmi Tan, Tarun Suresh, Daniel Mendoza, Thiago S. F. X. Teixeira, Ke Wang, Caroline Trippel, Alex Aiken
paper_type_zh: 功能验证的 RTL 代码数据与生成模型
best_for_zh: 研究 RTL 代码生成、硬件验证或执行式奖励的研究者。
one_line: VeriCoder turns natural-language RTL seeds into 125,777 simulation-passing specification–RTL–test triplets through teacher-guided test-and-repair loops.
VeriCoder 通过教师生成测试、仿真反馈和迭代修复，把 RTL 种子扩展为 125,777 条功能验证的规格—实现—测试三元组。
why: It changes RTL data acceptance from compilation to behavior under an executable testbench while preserving the validation evidence in each record.
inclusion_reason: VeriCoder releases RTL specification–implementation–testbench records accepted through executable functional simulation, enabling SFT and simulation-derived rewards.

title: Problem
问题
html: Existing RTL datasets usually verify only whether Verilog compiles, not whether the circuit implements the natural-language specification. Training on syntactically valid but functionally wrong examples teaches models to produce compilable hardware with incorrect behavior. The paper therefore studies how to add functional validation while scaling RTL data, using simulation feedback to repair both code and tests. Its direct artifacts are specification–RTL–passing-test triplets and the VeriCoder model fine-tuned on them.
现有 RTL 代码数据通常只检查 Verilog 是否能够编译，无法确认电路是否实现自然语言规格；把这类“语法正确但功能错误”的样本用于训练，会让模型学会生成可编译却行为错误的硬件。论文因此研究如何在大规模扩充 RTL 数据时加入真实功能验证，并用仿真反馈修正代码与测试。直接产物是自然语言规格—RTL 实现—通过测试平台的三元组，以及在该数据上微调的 VeriCoder。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The main contribution is a feedback-driven pipeline for functionally validated RTL augmentation. Starting from existing natural-language–RTL pairs, GPT-4o-mini generates testbenches that are executed in an HDL simulator. On failure, the RTL is iteratively repaired from logs, and tests are revised when they conflict with the specification. The released expanded_origen_126k contains about 126K natural-language, Verilog, and passing-test records. It upgrades the reward contract from “compiles” to “behaves correctly on specified simulations,” supporting RTL SFT, rejection sampling, and execution rewards.

核心贡献是一套反馈驱动的功能验证数据扩充流程。作者以已有自然语言—RTL 对为种子，让 GPT-4o-mini 生成测试平台，在 HDL 仿真器中执行；失败时根据日志迭代修改 RTL，必要时也修改与规格不一致的测试。公开的 expanded_origen_126k 含约 12.6 万条自然语言、Verilog 和通过测试记录。该数据把 reward contract 从“能编译”提升为“在指定仿真测试上行为正确”，可用于 RTL SFT、拒绝采样和执行式奖励。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Prepare seeds: Collect natural-language specifications and initial RTL, normalizing module interfaces and simulation environments.
  1. Generate tests: GPT-4o-mini creates testbenches and input sequences from each specification, first checking that the tests compile and run.
  1. Repair with feedback: Execute RTL against the tests. Compilation or waveform feedback is returned to the teacher to revise the implementation; tests are also revised when they misinterpret the specification.
  1. Accept and train: Only triplets whose final implementation passes the tests enter the approximately 126K dataset and are used for VeriCoder SFT. Reproduction must fix the simulator, timeout, teacher version, iteration cap, and seed-data licences.

1. 准备种子： 收集自然语言规格及原始 RTL，并规范模块接口与仿真环境。
  1. 生成测试： GPT-4o-mini 根据规格构造 testbench 和输入序列，先检查测试能否编译运行。
  1. 反馈修复： 执行 RTL 与测试；若失败，将编译或波形反馈交给 teacher 修改实现，若测试误解规格则同步修订测试。
  1. 接受与训练： 只有实现通过最终测试的三元组进入约 126K 数据集，再用于监督微调 VeriCoder。复现需固定 simulator、超时、teacher 版本、最大迭代轮数和种子数据许可。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The key evidence is a controlled fine-tuning comparison between functionally unvalidated data and VeriCoder’s validated data using the same base-model setting. Functional correctness is measured by simulation pass rates on VerilogEval and RTLLM. VeriCoder reports relative gains of up to 71.7% and 27.4% over prior best results, while ablations show that compile-only filtering is substantially weaker than test-feedback data. This supports the value of functional validation, but teacher-generated tests do not prove full specification correctness.

关键证据是同一基础模型在“未经功能验证的数据”和“VeriCoder 验证数据”上的受控微调比较。论文在 VerilogEval 与 RTLLM 上用仿真通过率评估功能正确性；VeriCoder 相对已有最佳结果最高获得 71.7% 和 27.4% 的相对提升，消融也显示仅编译过滤明显弱于测试反馈数据。该结果支持功能验证提高 RTL 数据效用，但测试平台仍由 teacher 生成，不能证明通过测试等价于完整规格正确。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior RTL augmentation mainly rewrites specifications or generates code and filters by compilation. VeriCoder’s novelty is not simulation itself, but a closed loop connecting test generation, simulator execution, and RTL repair, with tests also revisable when they misread the specification. This changes the acceptance rule: only code that survives functional feedback and passes the final testbench becomes training data, rather than treating all compilable code as positive. The model architecture and standard SFT objective are not the main innovation.
已有 RTL 数据扩充主要让模型改写规格或生成代码，再以编译成功作为过滤条件。VeriCoder 的新意不是首次使用仿真，而是让测试生成、仿真执行和 RTL 修复形成闭环，并允许在确认测试误解规格时修订测试本身。这样改变的是样本接受规则：只有经历功能反馈并通过最终 testbench 的代码进入训练集，而非把所有可编译代码视为正例。模型结构和普通 SFT 目标并不是主要创新。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Correlated errors: Tests and repairs are driven by the same teacher, so a wrong test may agree with a wrong RTL implementation. Independent human tests or sampled formal properties are needed.
  1. Verification coverage: Passing finite simulation inputs does not prove all temporal and boundary behavior, especially for complex protocols. Reuse should report coverage and mutation detection.
  1. Domain boundary: The data focuses on Verilog/RTL modules and does not cover repository dependencies, synthesis constraints, power/timing, or full FPGA/ASIC backends, so results should not be extrapolated to complete chip development.

1. 共错风险： 测试与修复均由同一 teacher 驱动，错误测试可能与错误 RTL 相互一致；应加入独立人工测试或形式性质抽检。
  1. 验证覆盖： 通过有限仿真输入不能证明所有时序和边界行为正确，复杂协议尤其可能漏检；复用时需报告覆盖率与 mutation 检测。
  1. 领域边界： 数据以 Verilog/RTL 模块为主，尚未覆盖仓库级依赖、综合约束、功耗时序或真实 FPGA/ASIC 后端，因此结果不能直接外推到完整芯片开发。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. RTL supervised fine-tuning: Train on expanded_origen_126k specifications, implementations, and tests, then report pass@k on independent testbenches.
  1. Pipeline reuse: Apply the generate-test, simulate, repair-from-log, and revalidate loop to private HDL corpora, producing execution-labelled records.
  1. RLVR: Use compilation and simulation as hierarchical rewards, while separating infrastructure errors, compile failures, and functional failures. Without a stable simulator, explicit interfaces, and independent hidden tests, pass scores should not be treated as reliable rewards.

1. RTL 监督微调： 直接使用 expanded_origen_126k 的规格、实现和测试训练代码模型，并在独立 testbench 上报告 pass@k。
  1. 数据构建复用： 对自有 HDL 语料运行“生成测试—仿真—日志修复—再验证”流程，输出带执行状态的训练记录。
  1. RLVR： 把编译与仿真结果作为分层奖励，但必须区分测试基础设施错误、编译错误和功能失败。没有稳定 simulator、明确接口或独立隐藏测试时，不宜把通过分数直接当作可靠奖励。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: VeriCoder upgrades compilable RTL into about 126K functionally validated triplets through simulation feedback.
  2. Method takeaway: A teacher generates testbenches; failures trigger code repair and, when necessary, correction of faulty tests; only final passes are accepted.
  3. Data takeaway: Each record includes a specification, RTL, and test assets for SFT or execution verification.
  4. Evidence anchor: Relative gains reach 71.7% on VerilogEval and 27.4% on RTLLM.
  5. Reuse decision: It fits module-level RTL, but independent tests must audit correlated teacher errors and inadequate coverage.

1. 一句话定位： VeriCoder 用仿真反馈把可编译 RTL 数据升级为约 126K 条功能验证三元组。
  2. 方法抓手： teacher 生成 testbench，执行失败后同时修代码和必要的错误测试，最终通过才接受。
  3. 数据抓手： 单条记录含自然语言规格、RTL 和测试资产，适合 SFT 与执行 verifier。
  4. 证据锚点： VerilogEval 与 RTLLM 相对提升最高 71.7% 和 27.4%。
  5. 复用决定： 适合模块级 RTL；使用前必须用独立测试测量 teacher 共错和覆盖不足。
